_readme: Every knob the picks routines use. Edit here, push to main, and the next run uses it - the routine prompts do not need to change.

books: the sportsbooks you can actually bet at, as The Odds API names them (draftkings, fanduel, betmgm, williamhill_us = Caesars, espnbet, fanatics, betrivers, ballybet). Picks only ever quote a price from one of these.
rules_from: the first date picked under these rules; the record line in each text counts from here.
min_odds / max_odds: the price range a bet may have (American odds). max_shift: the most the analyst may move the market's fair probability, in points.
tiers: [minimum edge in points, units]. First tier that fits wins. max_bets and max_units cap a single card.
Set a sport's stake_scale to 0 to keep getting its picks as tracking-only (0u) while it proves itself; 1 is full size.
